# Abeta React Ecosystem (`@abeta.dev/*`)

> Enterprise React 19 / React 18 design system and domain monorepo built with Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI primitives, strict TypeScript, and dual ESM/CJS outputs. Comprises four modular scoped packages (`@abeta.dev/ui`, `@abeta.dev/india`, `@abeta.dev/talent`, `@abeta.dev/auth`) plus the backward-compatible legacy omnibus `@abeta.dev/react-libs`.

- **Current Version**: `0.21.0`
- **Requirements**: React `^18.2.0 || ^19.0.0`, Node.js `>= 20.0.0`, TypeScript 5+
- **Live Storybook**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/
- **Full Single-File AI Reference**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/llms-full.txt
- **RAG Pre-Chunked Corpus (JSONL)**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/rag-chunks.jsonl
- **Context Graph (JSON-LD / GraphRAG)**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/context-graph.json
- **Machine Package Registry (JSON)**: https://abeta-dev.github.io/react-libs/registry.json
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/Abeta-dev/react-libs

## Modular Packages

Install only the domain slices your application needs:

- **`@abeta.dev/ui`** (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@abeta.dev/ui): Full accessible Tailwind CSS v4 + Radix UI design system (111 components, hooks, formatters, validators).
  - Entrypoints: `.` (client barrel), `./utils` (RSC-safe `cn`), `./pdf` (client-only `PdfViewer` isolating `pdfjs-dist`), `./hooks/use-toast` (`useToast`, `toast`), `./theme.css` (Tailwind v4 tokens), `./style.css` (precompiled zero-Tailwind CSS), plus micro-bundles (`./button`, `./dialog`, `./card`, `./badge`, `./input`, `./data-table`, `./table`, `./select`, `./form`, `./sheet`, `./drawer`, `./popover`, `./tooltip`, `./calendar`, `./date-range-picker`, `./command`, `./chart`, `./carousel`).
- **`@abeta.dev/india`** (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@abeta.dev/india): Zero-bloat India statutory compliance, tax math, NPCI UPI payment URIs, and regional FinTech UI.
  - Entrypoints: `.` (pure RSC/Server-safe: `validateGSTIN`, `validatePAN`, `validateIFSC`, `validateFSSAI`, `validatePincode`, `validatePhoneIN`, `validateBankAccountIN`, `calculateGSTSplit`, `calculateTDS`, `generateUpiPayUri`, `validateUpiId`, `parseUpiPayUri`, `formatLakhs`, `formatCrores`, `INDIA_STATES`, `INDIA_CITIES`, `INDIAN_LANGUAGES`, WhatsApp helpers) and `./react` (`'use client'`: `AmountSummaryCardIndia`, `UpiQrCard`, `LanguageToggle`, `BilingualTooltip`).
- **`@abeta.dev/talent`** (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@abeta.dev/talent): Verifiable credentials, interactive verification runners, skill diagnostics, and hiring pipeline UI (`'use client'`).
  - Exports: `ProofOfWorkCertificate`, `CheckpointRunner`, `DiagnosticQuiz`, `PipelineKanban`, `ProofOfWorkCard` (`MetricVerificationCard`), `MatchScoreGauge`, `RadarSweep`, `SalaryRangeDisplay` (`MetricRangeDisplay`, `CompensationRangeDisplay`).
- **`@abeta.dev/auth`** (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@abeta.dev/auth): Backend-agnostic authentication engine and accessible auth UI with HttpOnly cookie refresh, single-flight mutex, CSRF, and RFC 7636 PKCE.
  - Entrypoints: `./core` (pure TypeScript, zero React, zero `'use client'`: `AuthClient`, `createAuthenticatedFetch`, `AuthClientError`), `./react` (`'use client'`: `AuthClientProvider`, `useAuthClient`, `useAuthClientSnapshot`, `AuthProvider`, `useAuth`, `useToken`, `useUser`, `useOAuth`), `.` (full client bundle adding `AuthCard`, `LoginForm`, `SignUpForm`, `ForgotPasswordForm`, `OtpForm`, `OAuthButton`, `OAuthButtonGroup`, `TokenManager`, `MockAuthAdapter`, `useClickBackpressure`, PKCE helpers, OAuth icons), and `./core/use-click-backpressure`.

## Styling Setup

### Option A: Tailwind CSS v4 (Next.js App Router, Vite + Tailwind v4)

Import `@abeta.dev/ui/theme.css` after Tailwind and register `@source` for each installed `@abeta.dev/*` package so Tailwind scans component classes:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@abeta.dev/ui/theme.css";

@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/ui";
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/india";
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/talent";
@source "../node_modules/@abeta.dev/auth";
```

### Option B: Without Tailwind CSS (Vite, CRA, Tailwind v3, Plain CSS)

Import the precompiled cascade-layered stylesheet (`@layer abeta-ui`) once at your application root (e.g., `src/main.tsx`):

```tsx
import "@abeta.dev/ui/style.css";
```

## RSC vs `'use client'` Boundaries

- **Pure Server / RSC-Safe (Zero DOM, Zero `'use client'`)**:
  - `@abeta.dev/ui/utils`
  - `@abeta.dev/india`
  - `@abeta.dev/auth/core`
  - `@abeta.dev/react-libs/utils`, `@abeta.dev/react-libs/india`, `@abeta.dev/react-libs/analytics`
- **Client Components (`'use client'`)**:
  - `@abeta.dev/ui` and all component micro-bundles (`@abeta.dev/ui/button`, etc.)
  - `@abeta.dev/ui/hooks/use-toast`
  - `@abeta.dev/india/react`
  - `@abeta.dev/talent`
  - `@abeta.dev/auth` and `@abeta.dev/auth/react`
- **Client-Only Worker Isolation (`'use client'`)**:
  - `@abeta.dev/ui/pdf` (`PdfViewer`) isolates `pdfjs-dist` and `react-pdf` so Node.js SSR never evaluates browser-only `DOMMatrix` or worker globals.

## Key Signature Notes for Code Generation

- `calculateGSTSplit(amount, taxRate = 18, isIntraState = true, isTaxInclusive = false)` returns `{ baseAmount, totalTax, cgstAmount, sgstAmount, igstAmount, totalPayable }`.
- `validateGSTIN(value, { language?: 'en' | 'hi' })` (and `validatePAN`, `validateIFSC`, `validateFSSAI`, `validatePincode`) returns `undefined` when valid, or a localized error message `string` when invalid.
- `validateUpiId(upiId)` returns `{ isValid: boolean, error?: string }`.
- `generateUpiPayUri` and `UpiQrCard` accept `upiId` (not `payeeVpa`), plus optional `payeeName`, `amount`, `transactionNote`.
- `PdfViewer` accepts `file: string | File` (not `url`) and `onLoadSuccess?: (numPages: number) => void`.
- `ProofOfWorkCertificate` requires `certificateId`, `recipientName`, and `projectTitle`.
- `useClickBackpressure(handler, options)` returns `{ execute, isPending, cancelCooldown, wrapHandler }`.
